title: Fleet sessions on the operator host hold an admin gh credential: remove or narrow it (closes tag-ruleset option A gap)
description: Measured 2026-11-23: the gh account on the operator machine has admin: true on opum-ai/ward-cli and fleet sessions run with it. Under W-8 option A (docs/runbooks/protect-the-release-path.md) an admin-holding session can create a v* tag under the creation bypass with a plain git push. The operator-owned fix is a narrower credential for sessions. Not started; a credential change is the operator's, tier-3.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Fleet sessions on the operator host no longer hold an admin credential for opum-ai/ward-cli, or the operator records accepting the gap
